title: Penny J
content: On January 19, 1974, I had gotten off work, picked up my boyfriend so we could get dinner. Afterwards, I took him home, and then headed home myself. It was midnight and raining. I drove to the corner of a busy intersection. The traffic light was stuck on red from all directions. I was in the middle lane going straight in a 1968 Mustang. A Camaro was in the left turn lane beside me. We proceeded when it was our turn. The Camaro turned left, and I went straight. The driver saw a car speeding toward him from the left and accelerated to avoid it. II was hit broadside and knocked through the brick wall of a local bar. The car that hit me was black, and was driving with no headlights. The driver and passengers were a man, his wife, and child. A police officer arrived and accused me of drinking, though I hadn’t been. Another officer told him to leave. But the first police officer insisted on writing me a ticket, claiming I was at fault. I heard a child crying. I was disoriented from my injuries, and asked if I had killed a child. Suddenly, I was standing on top of the building and watching everything unfold below. I saw a woman who ran out of the building, shouting that I was dead. The officer pronounced me dead, and the ambulance crew confirmed it. My tape player kept repeating the song "Seasons in the Sun." A friend who had seen me at dinner earlier arrived on the scene. He was frantically asking where my boyfriend was, unaware I had taken him home. The scene was chaotic. Then, I realized I was speaking to a man beside me. He looked ordinary and I didn’t recognize him. I asked, "What the hell? I’m dead? I’m only 16!" He replied, "Yes, you are dead, but you shouldn’t be." I was confused. He explained the accident wasn’t part of my life plan. The other driver had made a terrible choice, altering my life path. He offered me the chance to return with him to reconsider my life plan, but I was too young to understand what he meant. I said, "I’m 16. I don’t want to die." He asked if I was sure. When I insisted on staying, he told me that they would be around if I changed my mind. Instantly, I was back in my body. The officer shouted; he still held my wrist and hadn’t performed CPR. The car was crushed, doors jammed. I came back to consciousness and demanded to be let out of the car. He refused, saying that I was dead. I told him that "No, I’m back." I asked him to retrieve my glasses. I told him that they were on the dashboard of the other car. He returned from getting my glasses from the other car. He was bewildered, and asked me how I knew where the glasses were. I told him, "I saw them from the roof when I was dead," I said. "Now that I’m alive, I can barely see." He lifted me out, and I teased him about his pig-shaped tie tack. In the squad car, "Seasons in the Sun" played again. We exchanged a look, and he turned the radio off. At the hospital, I was treated for eight concussions, two broken collarbones. I was bruised from head-to-toe. The officer stayed with me, even visiting after I was discharged. I told him about my experience, something I never shared with anyone else because it felt normal at the time. Healing took ten weeks. Fear of driving haunted me until 2021, when a heart attack led to another spiritual event. Six months later, I underwent two open-heart surgeries in 48 hours. I experienced another NDE. I also had a shared NDE in my 20s. Over the years, many spiritual events occurred, but I never dwelled on them until 2021. The man who spoke to me in 1974 has reappeared at key moments, such as warning me to call an ambulance during my heart attack. Looking back, these experiences always felt natural. I never thought they were strange. Now, my last NDE brought clarity to why I was having these experiences.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Accident, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I came back into my body, I was so confused about the whole process. I never really left. I saw no tunnels or had any family waiting. I only interacted with the guy that was there.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I could see everything happening around my body. But when I talked to the man, time seemed to stop.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My eyesight was greatly improved while I was dead. I noticed this because I normally need glasses; Yet, I saw my glasses in the car that hit me. I think I told him, 'Hey, I can see without my glasses.' Regarding mental or spiritual vision, I didn't understand what that meant at the age of 16.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was a little upset that I had died at such a young age. I was very confused about what the man was telling me about going back with him or staying. I remember thinking, 'What is a life plan? Who cares about it? I just want to live and have fun.'
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, The man told me my life plan was messed up through no fault of my own. He told me that I should probably go back with him and rethink my plan. I told him "No" I was too young to die. I wanted to live my life and have fun. He said my plan likely couldn't get back on track because of what occurred. I was oblivious to what he meant, which now seems strange. But that's how it was.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Other or several faiths, I never believed in organized religion and always felt there is the "One" and spirituality.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, Pretty much the same as I believed when I was very young. I do not belong to any religion.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I was 16, living a great life, no religion in our family, had a great mother and father and siblings. We weren't rich or poor money-wise. I had clothes to wear, food to eat and plenty of love. So beyond that, I didn't know anything about any of this and had never even thought about it. The most I did was imagine I saw ghosts in the attic when I was little.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I was with a man who was normal in size, around 50 years old, and wore a plain robe in a neutral color. I didn't recognize him by sight. I had no idea who he was; just that he was there for me.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I understood that a life plan probably meant I was here for a reason, but I didn't know what my plan was. It wasn't shown to me, only that I wouldn't be able to follow it.
Yes, The man told me I needed to go back and redo my life plan because my current plan was destroyed by someone else's decision. It could not be fixed.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes, I was told that we have freedom of choice within following our life plan. He also told me that the guy who hit me made a horrible decision that impacted my life plan. He said that the man will answer to that decision, but that I needed to now decide what I wanted to do. Again, I had no idea what any of that meant.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I didn't really think about God. Now, many years later, I think of God as just a name for "The One," which is not a person. As to how my life changed, I have had many spiritual events since then. I seem to be much more intuitive. It was also made clear that our soul lives on and this is just a blip in time.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I divorced and decided to stay single many years ago. I believe it has something to do with the NDEs and events.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I can close my eyes and remember every detail of the event. Other events have happened to me since then. I don't remember much else in detail before or after the events.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, Out of body experiences, other NDEs, participated in my aunt's death from 100 miles away. Know things are going to happen before they happen, but nothing serious. They may be premonitions.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Just the part about a life plan.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I knew it was real. I knew I experienced it. But I didn't understand it, and I am still working through that.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It was real and I'm still confused about parts of it. I'm not sure why I was saved by a Being during my heart attack, whom I could see he was working with my cardiologist to save me. I am not sure why many souls kept me from going into the light after my surgery. Completely at a loss about my plan what it was, why I can't complete it, and the impact of that.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I feel it was confirmed from my experiences that organized religion, the Bible, and other religious items are man-made and are only there to help us on earth in our plans to grow spiritually. But in reality, we are all one and we are all energy.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I have had many events, some very much alive, one dead with no heartbeat, one near death with a heartbeat, and one where my heart stopped for a few seconds. So there are several ways to have NDEs, which is what I feel I have learned.
